key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the extension checks usage with the OpenCode Go API.

key.name: show-percentage
key.summary: Show the percentage in the panel
key.description: Whether the panel indicator shows the usage percentage.

key.name: show-countdown
key.summary: Show the time until reset in the panel
key.description: Whether the panel indicator shows the time remaining until the displayed quota window resets (e.g. “Go 3% (3h 2m)”).

key.name: show-label
key.summary: Show the “Go” label in the panel
key.description: Whether the panel indicator shows the “Go” label.

key.name: last-updated-format
key.summary: How the last-updated time is shown
key.description: Show the last refresh time as a human-readable duration (“1m ago”) or as an exact clock time (“14:32”).

key.name: panel-mode
key.summary: Which quota window the panel reflects
key.description: Choose the window used for the panel percentage. “Most used” shows the window closest to exhaustion.

key.name: hidden-windows
key.summary: Quota windows hidden from the UI
key.description: List of quota window ids that should not be shown in the panel or popup.

key.name: notify-at-80
key.description: Show a notification when a quota window reaches 80% usage.

key.name: notify-at-90
key.description: Show a notification when a quota window reaches 90% usage.

key.name: notify-at-100
key.summary: Notify when a window is exhausted
key.description: Show a notification when a quota window reaches 100% usage.

key.name: notify-state
key.description: Internal state used to avoid repeated notifications until a quota window resets.

key.name: credential-revision
key.description: Incremented whenever the API key changes so the running extension reloads it.
